purpose: Clarify G09 as a portability classification gate whose result must match demonstrated scope, without requiring universal or cross-family portability for a model-specific release profile.
master_invariant: NO PROMPT MAY ENTER A RELEASE WITHOUT A PROMPT_ID + SPEC + TEST EVIDENCE + CERTIFICATION DECISION

gates.name: IMPROVEMENT
gates.required_trace: BEFORE -> FAILURE -> CHANGE HYPOTHESIS -> AFTER -> RETEST

gates.name: PORTABILITY CLASSIFICATION

classification_semantics.PORTABLE: Behavior observed across at least two declared model families under the applicable portability contract.
classification_semantics.MODEL_TUNED: Behavior is validated only with model-specific tuning/configuration that materially affects the workflow contract.
classification_semantics.MODEL_SPECIFIC: Behavior is validated on one declared model family only; release claims must name that demonstrated scope and must not imply portability.
classification_semantics.UNSUPPORTED: Available evidence is insufficient even for a model-specific supported claim.

gates.rule: G09 does not require a PORTABLE result. It requires an honest classification. A model-specific release may proceed only when customer-facing claims and certification scope are explicitly model-specific.

gates.name: PROVIDER GATES
gates.claim_scope_rule: Commercial copy must not exceed the G09 portability classification or G11 certification scope. MODEL_SPECIFIC is acceptable only when the release profile and customer-facing copy explicitly name the validated model scope.

change_rationale: V1 already allowed MODEL_SPECIFIC but G14 referenced F7_PORTABLE, creating an accidental contradiction that could force unnecessary cross-family testing or encourage overclaiming. V1.1 resolves the contradiction without weakening evidence requirements.
